content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. PayPal suspends accounts in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan—freezing funds for 180 days. Teachable, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy depend on these payment rails. If you sell courses or digital products in a restricted country, your entire business [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-23|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-13|The Real]]-behind-selling-software-without-stripe-account-8|architecture]] is built on platforms that explicitly exclude you. This post compares the tradeoffs of renting access to these platforms versus owning your commerce infrastructure at the base layer.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Renting platforms like Teachable or Gumroad gives you a dashboard to upload products, set prices, and collect payments—as long as Stripe or PayPal approve your country. You trade ownership for convenience. Owning your stack with tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments gives you direct control over hosting, storage, and payment processing. You configure the logic, own the data, and bypass platform restrictions. The tradeoff: you handle deployment and maintenance. Renting is faster to start. Owning is permanent.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Renting platforms exclude you by design. Stripe’s country list is fixed. PayPal’s account suspensions are arbitrary. If your country is not on their list, you cannot use their services. Owning your stack removes this dependency. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store globally. Supabase stores your orders without geographic restrictions. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from any country. The infrastructure is borderless because you control the components. Renting hits a wall. Owning scales globally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Renting platforms charge 5-10% per transaction plus payment processor fees. PayPal holds funds for months. Stripe’s payouts take days. Owning your stack with NOWPayments charges 0.5% for crypto payments—no hold times, no geographic restrictions. Transaction fees on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. The real cost of renting is revenue loss from excluded markets. The real cost of owning is the initial deployment fee. After that, your margins are permanently higher.
Stripe’s country list is fixed. Your commerce infrastructure should not be.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Renting platforms own your customer data, product files, and payment history. They can suspend your account or change their terms. Owning your stack means you control the database, the hosting, and the delivery logic. Cloudflare Workers automate order processing. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. The customer data stays in your Supabase instance. The tradeoff is clear: renting gives you speed but no sovereignty. Owning gives you sovereignty but requires configuration.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you are in a Stripe-supported country and value convenience, renting may work temporarily. If you are in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or any restricted region, renting is not an option. Owning your commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. It requires an initial investment to deploy, but the stack is yours forever. No platform can exclude you. No payment processor can suspend you. Your business runs on infrastructure you control. Choose renting if you can. Choose owning if you must—or if you’re building to last.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, your only permanent solution is to own your commerce infrastructure. Deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, handle backend logic with Cloudflare Workers, store orders in Supabase, and process payments with NOWPayments. This stack works in any country because it does not depend on Stripe, PayPal, or any geographically restricted service. The initial deployment requires configuration, but the result is a sovereign system no platform can shut down.
Owning your stack turns payment processors into commodities—not gatekeepers.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack in five steps: 1. Host your store on Cloudflare Pages for global accessibility. 2. Use Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing and file delivery. 3. Store customer data and orders in Supabase for full ownership. 4. Integrate NOWPayments to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with 0.5% fees. 5. Configure email delivery with SPF/DKIM/DMARC to ensure order confirmations reach customers. Test end-to-end before launching.

Yes. Deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, use NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and deliver files via Google Drive. This stack bypasses Stripe and PayPal entirely.
What happens if NOWPayments suspends my account?
NOWPayments does not suspend accounts for geographic reasons. It processes payments on-chain, so your store remains operational as long as your crypto wallet is active.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms on-chain, the funds are yours. Configure webhooks in NOWPayments to automate file delivery instantly.

Yes. The stack is designed for creators in restricted countries. Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments work globally without geographic restrictions.
What is the total cost to deploy this infrastructure?
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes deployment, configuration, and 30-day support. After that, your only ongoing cost is the 0.5% NOWPayments fee per transaction.
